summary.text: Ben Watson, a Republican, has served in the Georgia State Senate since 2014, representing Senate District 1.

paragraphs.text: He was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2010 to represent the islands district of Savannah.

He has been a primary care physician in Savannah since 1988. A native of Twin City, Georgia, he graduated from the University of Georgia and earned his medical degree from the Medical College of Georgia.
